title: 第23章 满嘴顺口溜，你是要考学啊！
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “你在教我做事？”“算是吧，先前你帮了我，现在我帮你，算是还人情。”“呵呵，那你说说看？”丁腾飞一脸冷笑，他并不认为陆阳能给到自已提供什么帮助。尽管这家伙和老兵们走得近，但那又怎么样？那帮家伙喜怒无常，翻脸比翻书还快，说不定哪天就倒霉了。陆阳：“记不记得班长曾经说过，你只是穿着军装，而我更像一个兵。”丁腾飞不以为意：“所以呢？”陆阳：“但是先前，你把我从人堆里拽出来，义无反顾冲进去干架时，我觉得你比我更像一个兵。”丁腾飞目光闪烁了一下，情绪有些复杂：“你到底想说什么？”陆阳直言：“你想不想像我一样，被老兵班长们区别照顾？”“废话！”“那就听我的，至少能保证你接下来不会再踩雷。”“我凭什么要信你？”“就凭这个新兵连，除了我这个老乡，你找不出第二个愿意搭理你的。学好学不会，想坏又坏的不彻底，夹在中间不难受吗？”丁腾飞忽然就被扎心了一下。隔三差五挨收拾，被孤立的感觉怎么会好受？他这一天天的都快憋屈死了，连个说话吐槽的人都没有，又不能上网玩手机！陆阳叼着烟，鼻孔带血的纸团子，瞧着要多社会有多社会：“小子，外面那套不管用的，来当兵最重要讲究什么，讲究服从，讲究实力。你有实力吗？”“怎么没有？”“唱，跳，rap，篮球，你会哪个？画画你也不会，内务也不会，啥啥都不会？”丁腾飞用力的竖起一根手指，学着李小龙样子摇了摇：“我会打架！”陆阳笑了：“你打得过班长，打得过那些如狼似虎的老兵吗？”丁腾飞：“......”陆阳：“你所谓的打架，就是人多欺负人少，是恐吓，威胁。打赢了派出所，打输了进医院。”“喝酒全是兄弟情，口供全是兄弟名。当混混很威风，欺负欺负老实人很过瘾，你不觉得很幼稚？”丁腾飞眼皮跳了跳，满嘴顺口溜，你是要考学啊！但对于这番话，他还是不由得陷入沉思。因为确实有一定的道理。陆阳深知自古真话最伤人，于是猛戳他的痛点。“部队里有比武，有格斗比赛，打赢了你就是英雄，还能获得荣誉。”“你是想下连以后去生产基地天天铲猪屎，混两年滚蛋，还是想带着一身功勋章荣归故里。”“然后惊呆你的父母，亲人；让曾经那些看不起你的老师，同学，朋友全部惊掉下巴，刮目相看？”“网络小说《兵王归来》系列看过吗？一代兵王回归都市，发现白月光被卖青楼，一怒之下召集千军万马......这样的情节他不爽吗？”“喂喂喂，有没有这么夸张？”丁腾飞觉着这家伙越说越离谱，连什么兵王归来都整出来了！但陆阳却一本正经的说： “未来，有无限种可能，义务兵两年说长不长说短不短。”“作为老乡，该说的我都说了；当狗熊，还是当英雄，完全取决于你自已。”“是书写《兵王归来》的传奇篇章；还是天天被班长连长不停的搞心态，下连以后当个养猪兵撰写《母猪产后护理心得》，你自已选。”说罢，陆阳便将烟头掐灭，转身离开。留下丁腾飞一个人愣在原地，被龙头里滴答滴答的水滴声，扰的他心烦意乱，不知所措。......陆阳刚进门，周凯东鼻尖就闻到了烟味。他知道，陆阳抽过烟了，也就意味着已经找丁腾飞谈过话。果不其然，没过一会儿，丁腾飞也喊了声报告回到宿舍里。但令人意外的是这小子身上并没有烟味儿，看来是被整怕了，不敢抽了.......此时，陆阳悄悄冲着周凯东使了个眼色，示意我的工作已经初步完成，接下来看你的了。周凯东也了然于心，随即选中两个人，要求全篇背诵《军人保密守则》。不出意外的，那两人都背诵的磕磕巴巴，不是漏字就是少几段，这让周凯东非常不满。“丁腾飞，全文背诵《军人保密守则》！”“是！不该说的秘密不说，不该知道的秘密不问，不该看的秘密不看......”“停，第七条是什么，背！”“不私自录制，复印，拍摄，摘抄，收藏秘密！”“很好！”周凯东适当表扬了一下丁腾飞，让其他人向他学习。这也是他入伍以来，被收拾了那么多回，第一次受到表扬。还真别说，这种感觉挺奇妙，还有点儿小爽呢。尤其是看到孔垄他们全都在憋屈罚抄，心情就更爽了。但这也引起其他人的不满，都知道丁腾飞之前犯错被罚抄了几百遍《保密守则》。这要是还不会背，可以找块豆腐一头撞死了。周凯东自然知道大家在想什么，于是故意说道。“书读百遍，其义自见！”“背不出来，就是没下功夫！”相比丁腾飞的小嘚瑟，其他人则显得更加憋屈。上学那会儿最讨厌的就是背诵全文这四个字，没想到进了部队还是没能逃过。“哎......！”借着班长中途上厕所的工夫，趴在床边的孔垄长叹一声：“当初就是怕读书怕上学，才来部队当的兵，怎么到了部队又是点评，又是背诵，上个思想教育课还得考试？”孔垄的话顿时引起不少赞同的声音，大家都在抱怨，早知道当兵还得学文化，就不来当这个兵了！或许是因为感同身受，让丁腾飞也有点儿惆怅。他不光怕学习，而且怕吃苦，再加上又是被家里逼着来当兵的，所以本能的就对这个地方很抵触。即便是入伍已经十几天了，却依旧找不到任何一丁点的归属感，反而越来越陌生。虽说，在外头混的日子挺风光，但先前陆阳那两句属实是给他整破防了。“打赢了派出所，打输了进医院！”“喝酒全是兄弟情，口供全是兄弟名！”这两句，简单明了的概括了社会人是什么德行。比这更混乱，更离谱，更毁三观的事情在这个群体里都屡见不鲜。人是群体性动物，如果丁腾飞还在外头和社会人一起厮混，肯定会对陆阳的话嗤之以鼻。但当他从一个环境，跳到另一个完全陌生的环境，且屡屡碰壁撞的头破血流后，他也会开始反思。这时，陆阳插话道：“说个大家不爱听的，其实咱们都是被淘汰下来的一批人。”孔垄不懂：“啥意思？”“你觉得，高考的意义是什么？”“上大学啊？”“不对，是筛选和淘汰。”陆阳的观点很快就引起众人注意。就连刚上完厕所，走回到门口的周凯东，都不自觉停下脚步。他并没有选择推门进去，这会打断大家的私下议论，他也想听一听陆阳所说的“淘汰和筛选”是什么意思？这时，指导员何镇涛也从楼梯走了上来，原本他是想去四班看看，顺带安抚一下四班新兵情绪的，却没想到撞见周凯东在这趴墙根？他轻声走上前，拍了下周凯东后背：“干嘛呢，鬼鬼祟祟？”周凯东回头比了个嘘的手势，示意他自已听。于是，门外就多了两个趴墙根的大壁虎。“就算你说得对，但学习又不能代表一个人的全部。”“我爸初中都没毕业，还不是照样当老板开路虎？”面对丁腾飞的反驳，陆阳倒也并不否认，而是摆事实讲道理。“你爸这样的个例，有几个？这是幸存者偏差，是极个别特例。”“就拿部队来说，咱们连长，指导员，营长，教导员，清一色都是军校毕业的高材生，甚至是研究生。”“从这件事，就能看出当兵也是需要学历，也是需要学习专业知识的。当然，只是想混两年就走的，另当别论......”众人议论纷纷，也间接意识到即便是进了部队，学习也很重要的。就和没有学历文凭，在外头找不到好工作是一个道理。在部队里，考试不合格，文化不过关的，很难留队。至于考学上军校，更是得投入巨大精力去复习，几乎等同于重新参加一次高考。孔垄听得抓耳挠腮：“卧槽，这么难的吗 ，那考学我指定是没戏了，我高考才两百多分。玩儿了一暑假，早就忘光了。”陆阳：“那就立功。两个三等功或一个二等功，就能保送提干。”“军校出来就是军官，手底下能带兵，像咱们连长那样，想收拾谁收拾谁。”“到时候什么一期士官，二期士官，全都得排着队上来敬礼。”门外，周凯东和何镇涛使劲憋着笑，但却让身后刚来的高峰脸都气绿了。他刚来，还没搞清楚状况，就被陆阳给叼了一顿。小兔崽子，有这么说连长的吗？我啥时候这么专横，想收拾谁就收拾谁了？此刻，三班内的新兵脸上全都露出笑容，这是一个美好的愿景。就连孔垄和丁腾飞都浮想联翩，幻想着有朝一日能成为军官。虽然，他们只是一帮新兵蛋子；虽然，这个梦很遥远；但万一呢，万一就实现了呢？人要是没有理想，那和咸鱼有什么分别？.咳咳！周凯东咳嗽两声，算是预警，然后才推门走进宿舍。大家立马收声，各自忙各自的事，但明显比离开前瞧着规矩的多。看了眼趴在床边装睡的陆阳，周凯东心中感慨良多，遥想当初自已刚参军那会儿，带自已的那个班长就是用这番话来忽悠的自已的。匆匆一晃，十年过去，他到现在都没达成那个目标。忽悠人的时候脸不红心不跳的，陆阳这小子有往班长方向培养的潜力......
content_en: "Are you teaching me how to do things?" "That's right. You helped me before, and now I'm helping you to repay the favor." "Haha, tell me about it?" Ding Tengfei sneered. He didn't think Lu Yang could provide him with any help.Although this guy is close to the veterans, so what?Those guys are moody and can fall out of favor faster than turning the pages of a book. They might be unlucky one day.Lu Yang: "Do you remember that the squad leader once said that you are just wearing a military uniform, but I am more like a soldier." Ding Tengfei didn't take it seriously: "So?" Lu Yang: "But before, when you pulled me out of the crowd and rushed in to fight without hesitation, I felt that you were more like a soldier than me." Ding Tengfei's eyes flickered, and his emotions were a bit complicated: "What exactly do you want to say?" Lu Yang said bluntly: "You want toDon't you want to be treated differently by the veteran squad leaders?""Nonsense!" "Then just listen to me, and at least you won't get into trouble again." "Why should I trust you?" "Except for me, a fellow soldier, you can't find anyone willing to talk to you.Isn't it uncomfortable to be caught in the middle if you can't learn well and be bad at the same time?How can you feel better about being isolated when you are being punished every now and then?He was almost exhausted every day. He didn't even have anyone to complain to, and he couldn't go online or play with his mobile phone!Lu Yang was holding a cigarette and holding a paper dumpling with blood in his nostrils. He looked at how many societies there were in society: "Boy, the things outside don't work. What's the most important thing about being a soldier? It's about obedience and strength. Do you have the strength?" "Why not?""Singing, dancing, rap, basketball, which one do you know? You can't draw, you can't do housework, you can't do anything?"Ding Tengfei raised a finger vigorously and shook it like Bruce Lee: "I can fight!"He said: "Can you beat the squad leader, can you beat those veterans who are like wolves and tigers?" Ding Tengfei: "..." Lu Yang: "What you call a fight is that there are more people bullying fewer people, it is intimidation and threats. If you win the battle at the police station, you will win."If you lose, you'll be sent to the hospital." "Drinking is all about brotherhood.Being a gangster is very powerful, and bullying honest people is very enjoyable.Don't you think it's childish?" Ding Tengfei's eyelids jumped, and he was talking smoothly, you want to take the exam!But he still couldn't help but think deeply about these words.Because it does make sense.Lu Yang knew that since ancient times, the truth was the most hurtful, so he poked at his pain point."There are martial arts competitions and fighting competitions in the army. If you win, you will be a hero and you will get honors." "Do you want to go to the production base and shovel pig shit every day after joining the company and get out after two years of work, or do you want to return home with a medal of merit?" "Then you will shock your parents and relatives; let the teachers, classmates, and friends who used to look down on you be shocked.Are you impressed?" "Have you read the online novel "The Return of the Soldier King"?A generation of Soldier King returns to the city, finds out that Bai Yueguang is sold to a brothel, and summons thousands of troops in a rage... Isn't he happy with this plot?"Hey, hey, is it so exaggerated?"Ding Tengfei felt that this guy was getting more and more outrageous, even the "Return of the Soldier King" story!But Lu Yang said seriously:"In the future, there are infinite possibilities. Two years as a conscript can be long or short." "As a fellow countryman, I have said all that needs to be said; whether to be a bear or a hero is entirely up to you." "Whether you want to write the legendary chapter of "The Return of the Soldier King"; or whether you want to be constantly teased by the squad leader and company commander every day, and then become a pig soldier and write "Experiences of Postpartum Care for Sows", it's your choice." After that, Lu Yang put out the cigarette butt and turned to leave.Ding Tengfei was left alone in the spot, disturbed by the sound of water dripping from the faucet, and he was distracted and at a loss.... As soon as Lu Yang entered the door, Zhou Kaidong smelled smoke on the tip of his nose.He knew that Lu Yang had smoked, which meant that he had talked to Ding Tengfei.Sure enough, after a while, Ding Tengfei also shouted a report and returned to the dormitory.But what is surprising is that this kid does not smell of cigarettes. It seems that he is afraid of being punished and does not dare to smoke... At this time, Lu Yang quietly winked at Zhou Kaidong, indicating that my work has been initially completed, and it is up to you next.Zhou Kaidong also understood this, and immediately selected two people and asked them to recite the entire "Code of Military Secrecy".Not surprisingly, both of them recited the words very stumblingly, either missing words or a few paragraphs, which made Zhou Kaidong very dissatisfied."Ding Tengfei, recite the "Code of Military Secrecy" in its entirety!" "Yes! Don't tell secrets you shouldn't tell, don't ask about secrets you shouldn't know, don't read secrets you shouldn't see..." "Stop, what is Article 7? Memorize it!" "Don't record, copy, photograph, excerpt, and keep secrets privately!" "Very good!" Zhou Kaidong praised Ding Tengfei appropriately and asked others to learn from him.This was also the first time he was praised after being punished so many times since he joined the army.Needless to say, this feeling is quite wonderful and a little refreshing.Especially when I saw Kong Long and the others holding back their frustrations, I felt even better.But this also caused dissatisfaction among others. They all knew that Ding Tengfei had made mistakes before and was punished by copying the "Code of Confidentiality" hundreds of times.If you still don't know how to memorize this, you can find a piece of tofu and hit it to death.Zhou Kaidong naturally knew what everyone was thinking, so he said deliberately."Read the book a hundred times, and you will see its meaning!" "If you can't recite it, you just haven't put in the effort!" Compared with Ding Tengfei's little pout, the others seemed even more frustrated.What I hated most when I was in school was reciting the four words "Full Text". I didn't expect that I still couldn't escape it after joining the army."Hey...!" Kong Long, who was lying on the bedside while the squad leader went to the toilet, sighed: "I was afraid of studying and going to school, so I came to the army to be a soldier. How come I have to comment and recite, and have to take an ideological education class and take an exam when I get to the army?" Kong Long's words immediately aroused a lot of voices of agreement. Everyone was complaining. If he had known that he had to learn culture to be a soldier, he wouldn't have become a soldier!Perhaps it was because he felt the same way that Ding Tengfei felt a little melancholy.Not only was he afraid of studying, but he was also afraid of hardship. In addition, he was forced by his family to become a soldier, so he instinctively resisted this place.Even though it has been more than ten days since I joined the army, I still can't find any sense of belonging. Instead, I am becoming more and more unfamiliar.Although life outside was quite prosperous, Lu Yang's two sentences before were really a warning to him."If you win the fight at the police station, if you lose the fight you go to the hospital!" "Drinking is all about brotherhood, and all confessions are about brothers' names!" These two sentences simply and clearly summarize the virtues of people in society.Things that are more chaotic, more outrageous, and more damaging to one's outlook on life than this are not uncommon in this group.Humans are group animals. If Ding Tengfei was still hanging out with people in society, he would definitely sneer at Lu Yang's words.But when he jumped from one environment to another completely unfamiliar environment, and repeatedly hit the wall and suffered a bloody head, he would also start to reflect.At this time, Lu Yang interjected: "Let me tell you something that everyone doesn't like to hear. In fact, we are all a group of people who have been eliminated." Kong Long didn't understand: "What do you mean?" "What do you think the meaning of the college entrance examination is?" "Going to college?" "No, it is screening and elimination." Lu Yang's point of view quickly attracted everyone's attention.Even Zhou Kaidong, who had just finished using the toilet and walked back to the door, stopped unconsciously.He did not choose to open the door and go in, which would interrupt everyone's private discussion. He also wanted to hear what Lu Yang meant by "elimination and screening"?At this time, instructor He Zhentao also came up from the stairs. Originally, he wanted to visit Class 4 and calm down the recruits in Class 4, but he didn't expect to see Zhou Kaidong lying on the wall?He walked forward softly and patted Zhou Kaidong on the back: "What are you doing, sneaking around?" Zhou Kaidong turned around and made a shushing gesture, indicating that he would listen.As a result, there were two more big geckos lying on the wall outside the door."Even if you are right, study cannot represent everything about a person." "My dad hasn't even graduated from junior high school, why should he still be the boss and drive a Land Rover?" Faced with Ding Tengfei's rebuttal, Lu Yang did not deny it, but presented the facts to make sense."How many cases are there like your dad? This is survivor bias, a very special case." "Take the army as an example. Our company commander, instructor, battalion commander, and instructors are all top students who graduated from military schools, or even graduate students." "From this incident, we can see that being a soldier also requires academic qualifications and professional knowledge. Of course, if you just want to hang out for two years and leave, that's another matter..." Everyone was talking about it, and they also indirectly realized that even after joining the army, learning is important.It's the same reason as you can't find a good job outside without a degree.In the army, it is difficult to stay in the army if you fail the examination and have a poor education.As for getting into the military academy, you have to devote a lot of energy to review, which is almost the same as taking the college entrance examination all over again.Kong Long scratched his head and scratched his head when he heard this: "Damn it, is it so difficult?, I’m sure there’s no chance of me taking the college entrance examination.I only got over 200 points in the college entrance examination.I’ve already forgotten all about it after playing for a long time.”Lu Yang: “Then if you perform two third-class meritorious service or one second-class meritorious service, you will be promoted to an officer.”Soldiers, like our company commander, will punish whomever they want."When the time comes, all the first-term and second-term non-commissioned officers will line up to salute."Outside the door, Zhou Kaidong and He Zhentao tried their best to suppress their laughter, but Feng Feng, who had just arrived behind them, turned green with anger.He had just arrived and before he could figure out the situation, he was grabbed by Lu Yang.Little bastard, did anyone say that about the company commander?When did I become so bossy and take care of whoever I wanted?At this moment, all the recruits in the third class had smiles on their faces. This was a beautiful vision.Even Kong Long and Ding Tengfei were thinking about becoming officers one day.Although, they are just a bunch of new recruits; although, this dream is far away; but what if, what if it comes true?If a person has no ideals, what is the difference between him and a salted fish?.Ahem!Zhou Kaidong coughed twice as a warning, then opened the door and walked into the dormitory.Everyone immediately stopped talking and went about their own business, but they were obviously more concerned about the rules than before leaving.Looking at Lu Yang who was lying on the bed pretending to be asleep, Zhou Kaidong felt a lot in his heart. He recalled that when he first joined the army, the squad leader who led him used these words to fool him.Fast forward to ten years, and he still has not achieved that goal.His face doesn't turn red when he deceives people, but Lu Yang has the potential to become a squad leader...
